headlines.description: — Valeri Nichushkin scored the eventual game-winner early in the second period, Nathan MacKinnon had an assist to add to his NHL-leading points total and the Colorado Avalanche hung on for a 3-2 win over the Philadelphia Flyers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nichushkin, MacKinnon help Avalanche increase NHL-best record in 3-2 win over Philadelphia Flyers

events.name: New York Islanders at Florida Panthers

headlines.description: — Carter Verhaeghe stayed red-hot with his sixth goal in his last six games, Seth Jones scored for the second consecutive game and the Florida Panthers closed a homestand by topping the New York Islanders 4-1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Verhaeghe scores again, Panthers close out homestand with 4-1 win over Islanders

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Carolina Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Macklin Celebrini set up San Jose's first two goals to tie for the NHL assists lead and added an empty-netter, helping the Sharks beat Carolina 4-1 on Sunday night for their first road victory over the Hurricanes since 2018.
headlines.shortLinkText: Macklin Celebrini has goal and 2 assists in the Sharks' 4-1 win over the Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Mikko Rantanen’s final-round score was the only goal of the shootout and Jake Oettinger made 27 saves as the Dallas Stars beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 3-2 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rantanen scores lone shootout goal as Stars rally past Penguins 3-2

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — St. Louis captain Brayden Schenn had two goals and an assist and the Blues beat the Montreal Canadiens 4-3 on Sunday to complete a three-game trip with their second victory in two nights.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blues captain Brayden Schenn has 2 goals and an assist in 4-3 win over the Canadiens

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Jack Eichel scored at 4:52 of overtime and the Vegas Golden Knights beat the New York Rangers 3-2 on Sunday night for their fourth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eichel scores late in OT as Golden Knights beat Rangers 3-2

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Washington Capitals

headlines.description: — Logan Thompson made 39 saves to record his 100th career victory and seventh career shutout, and the Washington Capitals defeated the Columbus Blue Jackets 2-0 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thompson earns his 100th win as Capitals down Blue Jackets 2-0

headlines.description: — Leo Carlsson scored two goals and rookie Beckett Sennecke had a goal and an assist in the Anaheim Ducks' 7-1 victory over the road-weary Chicago Blackhawks on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Leo Carlsson, rookie Beckett Sennecke lead first-place Ducks' 7-1 rout of road-weary Blackhawks
